summary: Tested the new Credit Memo linking/netting fix for the 'Purchase History from SAP' panel on Quota Allocation page (SH1.2CR). Backend endpoint GET /api/suppliers/sap-purchase-history/SH1.2CR verified via curl: Credit Memo RIDN-43-2026 correctly has document_type='Credit Memo' and reverses_invoice_id='RI-3748-2026'; Invoice RI-3748-2026 has document_type='Invoice' and reverses_invoice_id=null. UI verified via Playwright: Invoice '288' row (240 KGM) immediately followed by red-highlighted Credit Memo sub-row with arrow icon, '~ 288 / Reverses Invoice 288' caption, '-240 KGM' negative qty, then 'NET PURCHASE QTY (288): 0 KGM' summary row. All other invoices for SH1.2CR (309, MSTPL/26-27/244, MSTPL/26-27/163, MSTPL/26-27/158, NARAYAN/26-27/91) render as normal single blue 'Invoice' badge rows with correct qty/price, no missing/duplicated rows. Regression: SH1.2HR returns 1 clean row (no ParentItemUUID dup), SPC5WM returns 6 recent invoices all with document_type='Invoice', no column misalignment. Other panels on the page (Existing Purchasing Prices, ERP Real Purchase History, Goods Receipts from SAP, AI Quota Arrangement) all loaded/rendered normally with no errors or blank states for SH1.2CR.
critical_code_review_comments: _link_credit_memos() in sap_supplier_invoice_client.py correctly groups by (supplier_invoice_number, supplier_internal_id) and disambiguates multiple same-ref invoices by nearest date - sound logic, verified against real data.

buildPurchaseHistoryGroups() in QuotaAllocationPage.js correctly filters out grouped Credit Memo rows from top-level iteration and attaches them as sub-rows under their matching Invoice - verified rendering order matches source order (Invoice 288 appears before its Credit Memo in the raw list, which is also the desired display order).
Net Purchase Qty calculation (row.quantity - sum(creditMemos.quantity)) correctly returned 0 KGM for the SH1.2CR settled pair.
seed_data_creation: None - used live SAP data (SH1.2CR, SH1.2HR, SPC5WM).
